items.source:
Appends a single field or multiple fields that act as a unique identifier for a document. The identifier determines if a results document matches an already existing document in the output collection.
The aggregation results documents must contain the field(s) specified via on, unless it's the _id field.
items.translation:
追加一个字段或多个字段，这些字段作为文档的唯一标识符。该标识符用于确定结果文档是否与输出集合中已存在的文档匹配。
聚合结果文档必须包含通过 on 指定的字段，除非是 _id 字段。
